title: Wood-Burning & Electric Fireplace 101 — Liam + Jonathan Teachings
description: Canonical training content extracted from Drew's two May 16 2026 LEARNINGS .md files. The wood-burning section is Liam's training (with Duke the hornet anecdote about checking every firebox). The electric section is Jonathan's customer-walk-in pitch. Use in BSFA Smart Context Discovery + Recommendation phases.

open_face_wood.description: Traditional wood-burning fireplace with an open firebox. Heat lost mostly up the chimney. Customer asks for it because they love the smell, the experience, the crackle.
open_face_wood.honest_pitch: Open-face wood is mostly ambiance. If you actually want to heat the room, we need to talk about a different product.

high_efficiency_wood.purpose: real heat for entire single-level homes (multi-level needs furnace ducting)
features: louvers — inlet at bottom, outlet at top
wood-only — CANNOT be converted to gas
high_efficiency_wood.honest_pitch: High-efficiency wood is a real heater — customers heat entire single-level homes with these. 85% efficient. Wood-only, period.

wood_stoves.description: Separate freestanding category — not a fireplace. See stove section.

zc_signs: black metal box visible in firebox
panel lines (visible seams in firebox face)
masonry_signs: heavy masonry mass / large brick chimney
zc_vs_masonry_tells.trick_to_watch: Aftermarket metal door frames can hide masonry → looks like ZC but isn't. Always look beyond the front frame at the actual firebox walls.
zc_vs_masonry_tells.benson_inventory_skew: Benson doesn't really sell masonry — main line is ZC open-face. Customer with masonry = relatively unusual.

open_face_wood_to_gas.verdict: NO in-place conversion. Tear out + reframe + fresh install required.
options_for_customer: Tear out + install gas insert (sealed unit into existing opening) — $7K-$10K all-in
Tear out + install gas log set in the cleaned masonry — $2.5K-$3.5K all-in
Tear out + install gas log lighter (still burn wood, easier startup)

high_efficiency_wood_to_gas.verdict: CANNOT be converted at ALL. Period.
high_efficiency_wood_to_gas.honesty_principle: Don't promise. The customer with a high-eff wood fireplace and a gas itch needs to hear 'no, but here are alternatives' — not a soft sell.

drafting_honesty.liams_line: Be transparent. You know the answer is 'it depends' — tell them that.
details: Newer airtight homes harder to draft (sometimes cold rooms)
No manual predicts it accurately for a specific house

Customers asking 'will the room get cold?' should hear: 'Yes, that can happen with open-face wood. Every house drafts differently. We can do steps to mitigate, but I can't promise it won't be an issue.'

performance_metrics_summary.implication: 85 - 25 = 60 percentage points swing. Customer choosing 'I want wood + heat' is choosing between $0 heat (open-face) and real-house-heating (high-eff).

outside_air.rule: Outside air is NON-NEGOTIABLE on every wood fireplace install.
outside_air.liam_quote: You will not install a wooden fireplace without outside air.
outside_air.implication_for_bsfa: Wood fireplace quotes must include outside-air kit as a line item or installation note — Field Rule candidate.

hearth_requirements.rule: All wood-burning units REQUIRE a hearth by code.
hearth_requirements.exception: Electric fireplaces are the ONLY exception — no hearth required.
hearth_requirements.implication_for_bsfa: Wood fireplace quotes must include hearth line item or confirm existing hearth meets minimum. Limestone/bluestone hearth pricing in `hearth-pricing.json`.

burn_dynamics.customer_pitch_for_long_burns: If you load it right and bank a good coal bed at night, you can come down to embers in the morning.

sales_meta_lessons_from_liam: Be on the floor, not on the phone
Don't bluff — ask Rick (or now, ask Liam → going to phase out, then Drew leans on Mike Wallin for stone, Phil/Rodney for install, Jonathan for design)
Lead with hard numbers — 'this heats 2,000 sq ft' beats '85% efficient'
wood_burning.duke_the_hornet_lesson: Liam found a hornet living in a firebox; named him Duke. Reminder: open every firebox, check every unit. Add to closing/opening checks.

electric.context_principle: Customer says they want electric — but the question is WHY. 'Are you mainly trying to make the wall look finished, or are you counting on this for heat?' — Jonathan's qualifying question.

pricing_tiers.use_case: Customer says 'I don't care about heat' — cheap path
Most common path — modern look + light supplemental heat

pricing_tiers.reason_not_carried: Napoleon requires dealers to have 6 burning display fireplaces in showroom — not feasible for Benson space
pricing_tiers.competitor_carries: Other guys in town carry Napoleon fireplaces — fine to mention without disparaging
pricing_tiers.implication: When customer cites Napoleon fireplace, don't promise we can order it. Recommend Modern Flames or Dimplex alternatives.

gas_pricing_tiers_for_comparison.when_applies: Customer is tearing back to studs anyway
Tear from back side, custom-cut fit — don't have to redo wall

heat_rated_vs_standard_glass.rule_of_thumb: If you've got a furnace working in there, you don't really need the heat — standard glass, no fan, no remote. Just cosmetic.
heat_rated_vs_standard_glass.implication_for_quote_padding: Stripping fan + remote + going standard glass can save ~$1,500. Smart move when customer is heat-indifferent.

gas_vs_electric_btu_comparison.gas_use_case: real heat for a large area
gas_vs_electric_btu_comparison.electric_use_case: cosmetic, ambiance only, supplemental space-heater warmth

sales_techniques_to_steal.name: custom_cut_surround_panel_pitch
sales_techniques_to_steal.pitch: Our tech custom-cuts a piece of sheet metal to span the gap, silicone-sealed — exact to your opening, keeps cold air out. If you order one online, it is what it is.
sales_techniques_to_steal.when_to_use: Every time customer mentions sizing or 'I saw one online' — this is Benson's competitive moat against online buyers

sales_techniques_to_steal.name: a_la_carte_framing
sales_techniques_to_steal.pitch: Strip down the build when customer doesn't need heat — standard glass, no fan kit, no remote — just a light switch on the wall.
sales_techniques_to_steal.why_works: Customer feels respected (not upsold), doesn't pay for unwanted features, removes 'too expensive' friction

sales_techniques_to_steal.name: cellar_then_upstairs_flow
sales_techniques_to_steal.process: Walk hesitant customer through cellar options first → bring them upstairs to see the WORKING Modern Flames linear demo → upstairs becomes the 'wow' moment.
sales_techniques_to_steal.why_works: Working unit upstairs makes the others feel like reference points

sales_techniques_to_steal.name: honest_brand_comparison
sales_techniques_to_steal.principle: Jonathan flat-out tells customers gas looks better than electric when that's true. Doesn't talk them out of preference — gives them the truth, builds trust, keeps the conversation open.
sales_techniques_to_steal.tradeoff: Sometimes loses the electric sale; gains the gas sale + future loyalty

sales_techniques_to_steal.name: acknowledge_broken_demo_move_on
sales_techniques_to_steal.scenario: When in-store Modern Flames wouldn't turn on (old plastic chip, since redesigned to metal), Jonathan apologized casually and pivoted upstairs.
sales_techniques_to_steal.principle: No drama, no defense, just route around

sales_techniques_to_steal.name: stop_selling_when_customer_self_sells
sales_techniques_to_steal.trigger_phrase_from_customer: 'The smart thing is electric' (or equivalent buying signal)
sales_techniques_to_steal.next_move: Confirm the cabinet / opening dimensions and quote it. DON'T keep selling — start measuring.

facts: Glass pane ships ALREADY INSTALLED — unique among electric brands carried
Log inserts use REAL WOOD (cut, burned, treated) for traditional look
Concrete background DISCONTINUED. Current options: weathered gray concrete, black.
Selling point for install-anxious customers: pre-installed glass means no DIY assembly fear.
Premium electric: 3-tier flame, LCD screen, hologram-like depth
Benson does NOT carry Napoleon fireplaces and WILL NOT order them
Reason: Napoleon requires 6 burning display fireplaces in showroom — not feasible
Other guys in town carry Napoleon fireplaces — fine to mention without disparaging
Currently has a broken display unit (old plastic chip, since redesigned to metal) — needs replacement or pull off floor
Older 'hologram' angle-glass electrics produce NO heat output at all — purely decorative
If a customer says 'I don't care about heat,' these are the cheap path

things_to_verify: Is the Modern Flames cellar unit still broken (old plastic chip)? If so, swap for the metal-chip rev or pull off the floor — actively hurting sales.
Confirm $1,500 heat-rated vs standard glass delta against manufacturer pricing (Heat & Glo, Heatilator, Kingsman). Jonathan said 'roughly maybe $1,500 difference' — pin down per brand.
Confirm Napoleon fireplace ordering status — ANSWERED via Jonathan LEARNINGS: Benson does not carry, won't order, grills only.
Gas conversion ballpark ranges ($5K-$9K with no tear-out, $7K-$9K with full tear-out) — line up against 2022 install sheet + current service pricing (May 2026 refresh).

smart_context_panel_additions: When customer goal = 'real heat' + current fuel = wood → recommend high-efficiency wood OR gas insert; never gas log set
When customer goal = 'just looks finished' + budget low → electric tier 1 or 2
When customer mentions Napoleon fireplace → automatically surface 'we don't carry, but here's our alternative' script
When quote includes wood fireplace → enforce outside air kit + hearth as required line items
When ZC + gas insert combo detected → trigger Field Rule 2 (ZC gas insert acknowledgement)

field_rule_candidates.trigger: quote.lines contains wood_fireplace + no outside_air_kit line
field_rule_candidates.message: Wood fireplaces require outside air kit — Liam rule. Add line item before submitting.

field_rule_candidates.trigger: quote.lines contains wood_fireplace + no hearth (and no confirmation existing hearth meets 18" minimum)
field_rule_candidates.message: Wood fireplaces require a hearth by code. Confirm existing hearth or add hearth line item (see hearth-pricing.json).

field_rule_candidates.trigger: customer mentions 'convert high efficiency wood to gas'
field_rule_candidates.message: High-efficiency wood fireplaces CANNOT be converted to gas. Recommend full tear-out + new gas install.

field_rule_candidates.trigger: customer mentions Napoleon fireplace OR quote line names Napoleon FP
field_rule_candidates.message: Benson does not carry Napoleon fireplaces — only grills. Recommend Modern Flames or Dimplex alternative. Other guys in town carry Napoleon — mention without disparaging.
